ns2:section.sectionText: The ONL section is restricted to students who must complete the course fully online. If you receive a registration error, please email nres-ssc@illinois.edu requesting a registration override and explaining why you can only take the course fully online. If all seats are full, complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist to be added to the waiting list.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Nat Res & EnvSci ONL-UIUC, PHD:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, BSLAS: Earth,Soc,Env Sust-UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
